description: This file defines functions and types for managing GitHub discussions via GraphQL, including listing discussions, fetching specific discussions, discussion comments, and discussion categories. It includes GraphQL query structures, interface implementations, and utility functions for handling discussions within a GitHub repository or organization.

classes.name: DiscussionQueryResult
classes.description: Interface for all discussion query types, providing a method to get discussion fragments.

classes.name: DiscussionFragment
classes.description: Represents a list of discussion nodes with pagination info and total count.

classes.name: NodeFragment
classes.description: Represents individual discussion node details including author, category, and timestamps.

classes.name: PageInfoFragment
classes.description: Contains pagination information for discussion lists.

classes.name: BasicNoOrder
classes.description: GraphQL query structure for listing discussions without ordering.

classes.name: BasicWithOrder
classes.description: GraphQL query structure for listing discussions with ordering.

classes.name: WithCategoryAndOrder
classes.description: GraphQL query structure for listing discussions with category filter and ordering.

classes.name: WithCategoryNoOrder
classes.description: GraphQL query structure for listing discussions with category filter without ordering.

methods.name: fragmentToDiscussion
methods.description: Converts a NodeFragment to a github.Discussion object.

methods.name: getQueryType
methods.description: Determines the appropriate GraphQL query type based on ordering and category filter.

methods.name: ListDiscussions
methods.description: Lists discussions for a repository or organization, supporting pagination, filtering, and ordering.

methods.name: GetDiscussion
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific discussion by ID.

methods.name: GetDiscussionComments
methods.description: Fetches comments from a specific discussion with pagination.

methods.name: ListDiscussionCategories
methods.description: Lists discussion categories with their IDs and names.
